run.question: Which chain has the cheapest whole milk per litre?

answer.answer: E.Leclerc has the cheapest whole milk per litre, with a median of 1.41 EUR/l across 40 price observations (I used the median because the mean is pulled up by outliers). Auchan is next at 1.55 EUR/l (39 observations). Note that by mean, Auchan (1.83) is cheaper than E.Leclerc (2.00), so the ranking depends on the measure.
answer.sql: SELECT chain, count(*) AS n, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price_per_unit)::numeric, 2) AS median_eur_per_l, round(avg(price_per_unit)::numeric, 2) AS mean_eur_per_l FROM v_price_per_unit WHERE 'en:whole-milks' = ANY(categories) AND per_unit = 'l' AND chain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY chain HAVING count(*) >= 5 ORDER BY median_eur_per_l ASC LIMIT 50

run.question: How has the number of prices recorded changed year by year since 2022?

answer.answer: The number of prices recorded has risen every year since 2022: 4,511 in 2022, 6,490 in 2023, 27,641 in 2024, 44,736 in 2025, and 95,470 so far in 2026 (data runs to 2026-11-12, so 2026 is not a full year). Coverage is uneven, so the growth mainly reflects more observations being collected.
answer.sql: SELECT extract(year from date)::int AS year, count(*) AS prices_recorded, max(date) AS latest_date_in_year FROM prices WHERE date >= '2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

run.question: ¿Cuál es el precio medio por kilo de la mantequilla en Carrefour y en E.Leclerc?

answer.answer: Según los precios observados por kilo de productos con la etiqueta 'en:butters' (incluye subcategorías como mantequilla con sal o sin sal), la media en Carrefour es de 12,27 €/kg (mediana 11,94 €/kg, 218 observaciones de 87 productos) y en E.Leclerc de 10,18 €/kg (mediana 9,88 €/kg, 693 observaciones de 147 productos). Por tanto, E.Leclerc sale unos 2 €/kg más barato de media.
answer.sql: SELECT l.chain, count(*) AS n_obs, count(DISTINCT v.product_code) AS n_products, round(avg(v.price_per_unit)::numeric,2) AS mean_eur_per_kg, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v.price_per_unit))::numeric,2) AS median_eur_per_kg FROM v_price_per_unit v JOIN prices p ON p.id = v.price_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = p.location_id WHERE 'en:butters' = ANY(v.categories) AND v.per_unit = 'kg' AND l.chain IN ('Carrefour','E.Leclerc') GROUP BY l.chain ORDER BY l.chain LIMIT 10
